description: The desktop AI apps that make up the bulk of the demo table.
why: The four bundle ids that used to be must_contain are now must_find on the classifier, which is the layer that actually knows them. com.openai.codex is ChatGPT Desktop, not Codex CLI -- the obvious guess, com.openai.chat, is wrong, and pinning it here is the only thing that would catch a catalog edit getting it backwards.
